description: Approve a drafted price proposal so it can be pushed to the store. proposal_id is the id from list_commerce_proposals. Deciding is for the workspace owner, a person or an agent the owner has trusted with the commerce proposal approve scope; the audit trail records who decided. Approving does not push the price: use execute_commerce_proposals. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce proposal approve scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

proposal_id.description: The proposal id, as list_commerce_proposals gives it.

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit trail. Optional.

name: approve_commerce_proposal
